execution_contract.price_source: Frozen Yahoo-derived cache raw_close reconstructed to contemporaneous nominal prices with provider split events
execution_contract.schedule: Fixed calendar contribution; execute at next observed close within seven calendar days
execution_contract.professor_mode: Floor each contribution divided by execution price; do not carry or include residual cash; rank by terminal gain divided by actual spend
execution_contract.enhanced_no_carry_mode: Floor each contribution separately; hold each residual as cash but do not reuse it; include all cash in terminal wealth and XIRR
execution_contract.enhanced_carry_mode: Add scheduled contributions to cash; buy the maximum integer shares at each execution; carry residual cash; include cash in terminal wealth and XIRR
execution_contract.split_policy: Use provider split events; accept positive integer ratios only; quarantine missing acquisition and non-integer or reverse split ratios
execution_contract.dividend_policy: Exclude dividends from every mode because complete payment-date histories are unavailable
execution_contract.cost_policy: Gross core only; historical broker-specific and statutory schedules are not complete enough for a single reproducible cost claim
execution_contract.liquidity_policy: No slippage or participation cap because the frozen history cache has no complete historical volume series

primary_comparison: Same-row common cohort within each decision-date and investor-profile block

evidence_boundary.supplementary_test: Previously exposed outcomes; descriptive rerun only and never fresh confirmation

boundaries: No production writes, deployment, or model promotion
No historical sector labels or current-sector back-projection
No fractional shares in professor or executable modes
No invented corporate actions, prices, dividends, liquidity, terminal proceeds, or fee precision
No parameter tuning on previously exposed test outcomes
